newsitem.title: CANADA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-OILERS NIP ISLANDERS.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-OILERS NIP ISLANDERS.

text.p: Curtis Joseph had his sixth shutout of the season and Dean McAmmond scored the only goal as the Edmonton Oilers edged the New York Islanders, 1-0 on Friday.
"Bobby Essensa asked me the other day what was wrong with me the first 340 games of my career," said Joseph, who had only five career shutouts before this season.
In Anaheim, Sean Pronger scored twice and Teemu Selanne had a goal and three assists, leading the Mighty Ducks of Anaheim to a 6-3 defeat of the Hartford Whalers.
Paul Kariya added a goal and two assists, including his 200th NHL point, for the Ducks, who are 6-3-1 in their last 10 games.
Anaheim raced to a 3-0 lead in the first period on goals by Kariya, Brian Bellows and Selanne.

In Buffalo, Dominik Hasek made 34 saves for his league-leading 26th victory and Matthew Barnaby had a goal and an assist as the Buffalo Sabres moved into a first-place tie in the Northeast Division with a 3-1 triumph over the Dallas Stars.
The Sabres have won two straight and six of their last eight games to tie Pittsburgh for the lead in the Northeast with 59 points. The Penguins have played one fewer games.

At New Jersey, Todd Warriner scored early in the third period and Marcel Cousineau made 35 saves as the Toronto Maple Leafs escaped with their first tie of the season, a 3-3 deadlock with the New Jersey Devils.
Warriner put a wrist shot past Martin Brodeur from the right faceoff circle with 14:39 left in regulation for the game's final goal.
